name: 34637 · Land O Lakes, FL
findings: ZIP 34637 (Land O Lakes) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34637 (Land O Lakes) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
